subject: Quick check: security docs + timing for AuroraEdge POC
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@auroraedge.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@auroraedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check: security docs + timing for AuroraEdge POC

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning — appreciated the context on your latency targets and HIPAA-adjacent data flows. As discussed, I’m attaching our security packet and a one-sheet that outlines common deployment patterns we recommend for AuroraEdge-like workloads.

Attachments:
- redwood_security_packet_20270623.pdf (attachment/pdf)
- networking_matrix_auroraedge.xlsx (attachment/xlsx)

Quick recap and proposed next steps: 
- What we shared: security/compliance packet (SOC 2 summary, data handling, encryption, KMS integrations), network matrix, and a brief SLA summary.
- Requested from you: primary contact for security review (if different from Marcus), any specific compliance artifacts you need beyond the packet, and an ideal timeline for a short POC.
- Proposed mutual action plan:
  1) Security review by AuroraEdge security team (we can join) — target by 7/6
  2) Quick infra checklist + access window for POC — target by 7/9
  3) POC kickoff week of 7/12 (2–3 day focused run)

If your priority has shifted or you need a different cadence, please flag — we can compress or push timelines. If helpful I can loop in our security engineer for a 30-min call to walk through any questions.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/AE-8721

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
redwood.com

From: Elena Park <elena@auroraedge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@auroraedge.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick check: security docs + timing for AuroraEdge POC

Thanks, Monica — and thanks for the packet. I skimmed the SOC 2 summary and the encryption section looks straightforward. Two initial asks from our side: 

1) Can you share a simple network diagram showing which endpoints need to be whitelisted for a private VPC deployment? (Marcus’ team will want that.)
2) What SLA targets are available for Dedicated vs Hosted during the POC? We’re trying to size expectations for the product team.

I’ll route the packet to our security reviewers — they usually take 5–7 business days. If you can provide the network diagram it will help speed things along.

—Elena
Elena Park
Head of IT & Security | AuroraEdge
elena@auroraedge.com | +1 (206) 555-0127

Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick check: security docs + timing for AuroraEdge POC

Looping back — wanted to check whether the security review is still on track for early next week. Given your goal to lock POC funding in mid-July, I want to make sure there are no blockers we can help clear proactively. 

Options if you’re short on bandwidth: 
- I can schedule a 20–30 min walkthrough between your security reviewer and our security engineer (we’ll bring the network diagram and a short deployment runbook).
- We can mark this as lower priority and shift the POC window to late July if that works better.

If you could flag the priority (high / medium / low) and the primary security contact we’ll align the next steps. Quick note: I uploaded a preview of the packet and the network matrix to the HubSpot record and a Drive link in case anyone on your team prefers those.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/AE-8721
Drive preview: https://drive.google.com/file/d/secure-packet-preview

Thanks — appreciate the nudge back.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Quick check: security docs + timing for AuroraEdge POC

Hi Monica & Ben — apologies for the delay. Our security team completed the packet review this morning. Summary: no high-severity blockers; two small asks below that we can handle during the POC:

- Can you confirm transient logs are retained in our VPC only (we’ll need the short retention policy snippet for contract language)?
- Minor clarification on key rotation cadence when using customer-managed KMS.

Both items look like quick clarifications. Once we have those snippets we’re ready to proceed with the access window. Can you do a 20-min sync tomorrow to finalize the POC schedule?

Thanks,
—Elena
Elena Park
Head of IT & Security | AuroraEdge
elena@auroraedge.com
